analysis.title: Market Rhythm, 19 November 2026
key_insights: Nasdaq 100 futures opened strong from a mid-November higher low and are running into a resistance cluster at 28,200 (200dma), 28,700 and 28,800. Upside needs a clean break through the cluster.

Dow Jones Industrial Average printed its lowest close since June and fell below the 200dma for the first time since April. The desk calls the price action a clear downtrend and says bulls must reclaim 50,550/780 quickly to stabilize.
KOSPI is holding above 4,950/00 support but has not rebounded meaningfully. A decisive break below 4,950/00 would weaken the setup and invite more downside.
Hang Seng closed at its lowest level since June and sits just above support. A bounce is possible, but a break lower would confirm deeper, longer-term technical damage.
Spot gold (XAUUSD, 3,735) is under pressure and testing daily support near 3,730 and a weekly zone at 3,715-3,700. A clear break below 3,700 risks another leg lower into next week.
AUDUSD (0.6700) sold off sharply and is probing 0.6660-0.6650 support. Short-term oscillators are oversold, and the desk expects 0.6660-50 to hold on a first test.
risk_factors: A break below 4,950/00 on KOSPI would invite more downside.
A break below Hang Seng support would confirm deeper, longer-term technical damage.
A clear break below 3,700 in spot gold risks another leg lower into next week.
Nasdaq 100 futures could stall at the 28,200-28,800 resistance cluster.
vol_and_positioning: Short-term oscillators on AUDUSD are oversold, which the desk says suggests downside momentum may pause.
